messages.subject: trap happy/shy
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have been using the secr package in R and have found the best model using the AIC comparison to be the behavioral response to a site. I would like to check if this response is positive or negative, but I am not sure what I need to compare to show this, can you point me in the right direction? I would appreciate it! 
Kind regards
Tara

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: trap happy/shy
parts:
Tara
The direction of the response is shown by the beta coefficient for g0.bkTRUE (see for example the table of beta parameter values that is displayed when you print a fitted model object). Positive values indicate a positive response. For estimates of the two levels of the real parameter use predict(fittedmodel, newdata=data.frame(bk=0:1)) where bk=0 corresponds to the naive state.
Murray
